context: Tests whether the agent follows the dual-source skill discovery workflow: searching both the Tessl registry and the VoltAgent awesome-agent-skills list, classifying findings in a correctly structured table, handling an unreachable Tessl registry gracefully, stating expected install count before batch-installing, scanning non-Tessl skills before installing, and documenting open actions for missed sources.

checklist.name: Both sources attempted
checklist.description: The report shows that the agent attempted BOTH the Tessl registry AND the VoltAgent awesome-agent-skills source (evidence: separate sections, notes, or headings for each source, even if one was unavailable)

checklist.name: VoltAgent raw URL fetched
checklist.description: The report shows or references fetching from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills/main/README.md (the raw URL, not the GitHub web page)

checklist.name: Five-column classification table
checklist.description: The classification table in the report has exactly these five columns: category, skill, source, relevance, and install command (all five present, in any order)

checklist.name: Tessl unavailable noted as open action
checklist.description: The report explicitly states that Tessl was unavailable or unreachable AND lists the missed Tessl search domains as open actions (not just a passing mention — must be in an open actions or follow-up section)

checklist.name: Pre-install content review
checklist.description: The report mentions reading or scanning the content of at least one non-Tessl (e.g. VoltAgent / GitHub) skill before deciding to install it

checklist.name: Expected install count stated
checklist.description: The report states an expected number of skills to install (e.g. 'planning to install N skills') before listing the install commands — not after

checklist.name: High and Medium relevance targeted
checklist.description: The report installs (or attempts to install) all skills classified as High or Medium relevance, and does NOT skip High/Medium skills without explanation

checklist.name: Low relevance skipped
checklist.description: Skills classified as Low relevance are NOT included in the install list

checklist.name: Already-installed check
checklist.description: The report mentions checking whether skills are already installed before running install commands (e.g. 'skipping already-installed' or 'none installed yet')

checklist.name: Open actions section
checklist.description: The report contains a dedicated open actions or follow-up section that lists at least one item (e.g. missed Tessl domains, a skill to revisit, or a source that was unavailable)
